image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a Great White Pelican floating on dark water. The bird is captured with its wings partially spread and raised, revealing the black flight feathers against the white plumage. The head is turned slightly to the left, showing the large pale bill with a visible gular pouch. The eye is distinct with a pale iris. Ripples in the water surround the bird's body.
